10 07-20  Tiffany Parker with sons Kamare and Kendrick.. Ms. Parker is a native of Indianapolis. She received a basketball scholarship to attend a junior college. Afterwards, she received a bachelor's degree from Robert Morris Univ. and returned to Indianapolis. Tiffany founded the S.E. Community Center which led to employment with the county. She has coached kids' basketball programs, is currently teaching an adult Zumba class and is preparing to roll out a Karate class for Kids in the fall. Tiffany looks forward to her new neighborhood and is excited about owning a home with a yard for her two boys. The boys are hoping to have a tree house.  jv
